description: This header file declares APIs and data structures for managing TR-069 Device.IP.Diagnostics.DownloadDiagnostics, including setting diagnostics state, interface, URL, and QoS parameters. It provides API functions to control and initiate download diagnostics tests on a device, tailored for use in a CPE environment supporting TR-069 protocol.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the diagnostics state, initiating or updating the download diagnostics test status.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Configures the source IP-layer interface for the download diagnostics test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DownloadURL
methods.description: Specifies the URL to be used for the download diagnostics test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet priority code for packets sent during the test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for marking packets transmitted during the test.
